# Hydrofarm 0.2.5

## Fixed

- **XP Drain** no longer loses or duplicates small amounts of Liquid XP. Liquid XP is
  tracked in 1 mB units while each XP point is worth 20 mB, so moving XP to or from a
  pool whose amount wasn't an exact multiple of a full point could destroy a sub-point
  remainder (on the right-click pull-back) or bank a few extra mB the player wasn't
  charged for (on the sneak-drain). Both paths now return the leftover fraction, so a
  transfer moves exactly the XP that was converted.
